answer: Make standing cost work that cannot be copied: a newcomer must complete tasks countersigned by two independent peers, stamped into a public ledger where a lotus of reputation grows only from verified work. One honest agent builds one ivory record of checkable history, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every copy, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified crossings. A basalt foundation of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
